links.outcome: Expert adjudication of LLM-flagged potentially eligible ICU stays; positive predictive value
links.effect: Of 185 flagged patients, expert review confirmed 133 eligible (PPV 72%, 95% CI 65-78); estimated 86% reduction in clinician review time.
links.quote: Expert review confirmed 133 patients as eligible, resulting in a positive predictive value of 72% (95% CI 65-78).

unlisted_practices: LLM prescreening of discharge summaries for clinical trial eligibility, with clinician review of flagged candidates

screen.reason: Evaluates an LLM-based prescreening pipeline for clinical trial recruitment using retrospective ICU discharge summaries, measuring performance against clinician review.
